project=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();raw=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
if raw!=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('PROBATA_OUTPUT','/missing-root-marker')).resolve() or not raw.is_dir():
 raise SystemExit('exact Linux coordinator output root required')
for filename,encoded,want in [('qualified-grow-entry.py',ENTRY_COMPRESSED_BASE64,ENTRY_SHA256),('qualified-grow-expected.json',EXPECTED_COMPRESSED_BASE64,EXPECTED_SHA256)]:
